title: Qa Automation Testing Engineer
description:
Roles and Responsibilities 
 Design, develop, and execute automated tests using Selenium WebDriver for web applications.
 Develop test cases and scenarios to ensure comprehensive coverage of application functionality.
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify requirements and prioritize testing efforts.
 Analyze defects reported by stakeholders and work with developers to resolve issues.

Key Skills: QA Automation,C#,Java,JMeter,Performance Testing,Load Runner,Rest Assured,API Testing
